# CurricularFace backbone (vendored)

Copied verbatim from PKU-YuanGroup/ConsisID, `util/on_going_module/curricularface/` (branch main,
2026-09-24), which adopts it from Tencent/TFace `recognition/torchkit/backbone`.
License: Apache-2.0 (TFace, ConsisID). Used by `ayase.modules.facesim` exactly as ConsisID's
official `eval/get_facesim_fid.py` uses it: `get_model('IR_101')([112, 112])`.
